Authenticate beyond the packaging. Connect the evidence with EPCIS.

Once a device leaves its packaging, its label can no longer tell the whole story. Bring authentication of the physical item into your supply-chain data.

iTRACE’s 2DMI marking and authentication capabilities help teams assess the device itself. Trust.med connects that evidence with EPCIS records so partners can use it when reviewing a receipt, return, or item entering service.
